entities.name: Obuun
entities.description: A young Mul Daya elf raised among the kor on the Bala Ged Skyclave, who returns to Riverroot Village a thousand years before he becomes a powerful spirit and leader, desperate to prove himself.

entities.name: Nezzan
entities.description: An aged Mul Daya and leader of Riverroot Clan who advises Obuun to be patient.

entities.name: Ayya
entities.description: Obuun's mother, a brakeguard who vanished years ago and whose spirit guides him from the bone cavern.

entities.name: Dykaar
entities.description: Obuun's uncle, who loves the kor and bought Obuun's kor armor, and Obuun's only living family.

entities.name: Obuun's father
entities.description: Obuun's father, who disappeared years ago like his mother.

entities.name: Surrakar
entities.description: A sickly green, tailed, scaly creature in the caves beneath the Riverroot Tree, which attacks Obuun and is killed when he kicks it into a waterfall.

entities.name: Mul Daya
entities.description: The elven people of the Guum Wilds, who are slow to trust and worship ancestors.

entities.name: Riverroot Clan
entities.description: The Mul Daya clan living in the Riverroot tree, led by Nezzan.

entities.name: Brakeguards
entities.description: Mul Daya wilderness guards who patrol the Guum Wilds and fight surrakar.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: The people of the Bala Ged Skyclave who raised Obuun and are seen by the elves as replacing their ways.

entities.name: Bala Ged Skyclave
entities.description: The kor city floating above the Guum Wilds.

entities.name: Guum Wilds
entities.description: The wild forest of Bala Ged where Riverroot Village stands.

entities.name: Riverroot Village
entities.description: The Mul Daya village built in the great Riverroot tree.

entities.name: Riverroot Tree
entities.description: The massive tree housing all the elves of Riverroot, whose roots reach into the caves.

entities.name: Surrakar caves
entities.description: The cave system beneath Riverroot that holds a cavern of Mul Daya bones.

entities.name: Bone cavern
entities.description: A huge chamber of Mul Daya bones beneath the Riverroot Tree where Obuun senses his ancestors.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: The Zendikari continent holding the Guum Wilds.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane, whose lifeblood Obuun feels.

events.summary: Obuun, angry at the brakeguards for leaving him behind, argues with Nezzan on the lookout over Riverroot Village.
events.quote: The surrakar took my parents from me, and now the brakeguards are taking my chance to fight back.

events.summary: Obuun slips away down a rope in his kor armor to hunt surrakar alone.
events.quote: Nobody would notice one elf gliding down a rope from platform to platform

events.summary: Obuun stalks a surrakar into its caves and is nearly killed in the fight.
events.quote: Steel clashed against steel, throwing up sparks that lit the dim tunnel.

events.summary: Lost in the tunnels, Obuun hears a voice saying Let her in and hides, believing he may be beneath the Riverroot Tree.
events.quote: Was he beneath the Riverroot Tree?

events.summary: Obuun falls into a bone cavern and senses the spirits of Riverroot Clan, finding his mother's bone fragment.
events.quote: he could at last sense the spirits of Riverroot Clan

events.summary: In a vision of his mother and a fight, Obuun finds her short sword and fends off the surrakar.
events.quote: Obuun brought his mother's short sword up just in time to stop the surrakar from lopping his head off.

events.summary: Obuun's power over earth awakens, raising a stone slab and cracking a root; he stops before uprooting the tree.
events.quote: a slab of stone was rising up beneath his feet, responding to his need

events.summary: Obuun realizes bringing back the bones would uproot the Riverroot tree and halts the stone.
events.quote: to bring back the bones would be to uproot the tree

events.summary: The surrakar bites Obuun's shoulder and he drives the sword in deeper before falling unconscious.
events.quote: The surrakar worried at his shoulder

events.summary: Obuun's mother's spirit tells him recklessness is not how Mul Daya prove themselves and that he should let Riverroot into his heart.
events.quote: Recklessness is not how Mul Daya prove themselves. Patience is.

events.summary: Green sparks fill Obuun and he feels the Riverroot tree, his connection to Zendikar and the leylines.
events.quote: The tendrils of the Riverroot tree had buried themselves inside him

events.summary: Obuun climbs a waterfall to escape and patiently retrieves his mother's sword, kicking the surrakar to its death.
events.quote: He kicked the creature as hard as he could.

events.summary: Obuun emerges into the night and returns home; days later the village burns the recovered bones in pyres.
events.quote: The pyres were the final step for Riverroot Village

relations.note: Nezzan is the leader of Riverroot Clan.
Obuun belongs to the clan though the brakeguards distrust him.
relations.quote: he could at last sense the spirits of Riverroot Clan

relations.note: Dykaar is Obuun's uncle and only living family.
relations.quote: The armor that Uncle Dykaar had bought for Obuun

relations.note: The surrakar are blamed for taking Obuun's parents.
relations.quote: The surrakar took my parents from me
open only to trained brakeguards like Ayya, Obuun's mother

relations.note: The surrakar lair lies in the Wilds beneath the tree.
relations.quote: He was close to the surrakar lair.
